g.text: Two components | image | sequential | seed 8301 | main pH comparisons
White dashed: clean scoring boundary. Dark: inferred zero level. Common, unclipped color range across rows and times.
MSE uses the full clean binary reference; it is an offline evaluation quantity. Times are numerical relaxation units.
